notes.title: Railroad Expansion Update
notes.content:
[h3]The Railroad Expansion Update is here![/h3][p][/p][p]Build a railroad across the Landscape or between you bases.
With a coal powered cart you are able to transport lots of items from point A to point B.[/p][p]The cart has it's own inventory that can be filled up.[/p][p]Four types of Rails (Left Turn, Right Turn, Uphill, Downhill) allow a dynamic track placement. [/p][p] [/p][h3]This Update also contains bug fixes![/h3][p]
- Rainbarrel water levels are saved
- Growth levels of planted crops are saved
- Multiplayer sound fixes
- Mulitplayer UI fixes
- Replaced the "Sharkheads" with more suitable Character
[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you for the Feedback!  [/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Hauntsville 1.1 (Content Update)
notes.content:
[h3]The first content update is here![/h3]

- Better Performance
- 3 new Monsters
- More Action 
- Most of the crates and wooden boxes can be looted
- More loot
- New Buildings on the map
- Dismounting the storage box will drop its items instead of vanishing
- Golden Revolver fixed

[h3]Thanks for the feedback! If you like the updates please consider leaving a Review for Hauntsville, it helps a lot! [/h3]

[h3]Previous Patches:[/h3]

- Enemy AI is better at switching between base attacks and player attacks
- Enemy AI is faster at decision making
- Demons don't attack a dead player
- Improved NPC Spawn/Despawn System
- Scrolling through the hotbar to equip items is now possible
- Added a craftable standing torch to illuminate larger areas around the base
- Added a tent that allows you to sleep and save outside of the base when exploring
- Base Doors open easier
- Repair tutorial added to tutorial part of the Game (Press 'B' when looking at a base part to see HP)
- Changed some furniture collision boxes
- Shotgun reload bug fixed
- Deer don't despawn when player is nearby
- Floating Orbs can be looted for gunpowder
- Defense spikes damage enemies and don't block close gunshots
- Defense walls extend down further when placed to each other facing downhill (similar to foundation placement)
- Added invert mouse Y-Axis option
- Guns can't destroy the base anymore by accident
- If the chest gets destroyed the items inside will be dropped instead of vanishing

notes.title: Thank you for the feedback and reports!
notes.content:
I want to thank all of you so much for providing feedback on the game and sharing the bugs you've experienced so that I can address them. Since launch, I've already released two patches and am working on a third patch now! You can find the changes/improvements I've already made below.

[h3]Patch #1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Short loading screen (4 seconds) for fast travel to prevent players from falling through the ground.
[*] Longer dismount time of 60 seconds for placed building parts. (Press X to remove placed part)
[*] Furnace doesn't overlap chest and can process Gold Nuggets to Gold Bars. 
[*] Audio levels of tools has been adjusted to be more balanced.
[/list]

[h3]Patch #2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tweaked the network settings for better multiplayer performance
[*] Overall performance should be better as well
[*] Adjusted the audio levels
[*] Optimized the overlaps for bed, chest and doors in the base to not block the interacting of each other.
[*] Increased the gunpowder amount that can be looted
[/list]

[h3]Upcoming fixes (coming very soon)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occasional item loss when using the Furnace
[*] Adjusted jump velocity
[*] Stats UI updating properly when loading the game
[*] Quests are no longer set back when reading old quest letters
[/list]

Again, thank you so much for your feedback! If you have any feedback to share or experience any issues, please let me know in the Bugs & Feedback discussion forum here on Steam or in the Hauntsville Discord!

notes.title: Hauntsville is available NOW!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all the support and the feedback along the way. It really helped during development and kept me motivated! I'm happy to announce that Hauntsville is finally here! 

[previewyoutube=vlIs-Vc4yZo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🤠 Explore and survive the cursed West[/h2]
Search the haunted town for supplies or try to survive on what you can find in the wild, pursued by creatures straight from North American folklore! Use your guns or tools to fight off a variety of supernatural beasts. Keep your eyes open, there could always be something hiding in the woods.

[h2]⚒️ Build and Farm[/h2]
In a dynamic environment with changing weather and dark nights, it is essential to have shelter. Use the resources available in the wild. Everything from trees and plants to wildlife and ores found in abandoned mines, to help build your base and survive. You can be very creative when setting up your base and defense methods! Grow your own crops and collect rainwater to make your life a little easier.

[h2]❔ The Mystery[/h2]
Find out more about the disappearance of the population and the curse that lies upon the mountain valley. There is plenty of information left behind by fleeing inhabitants. And remember, it's always a good idea to have some friends with you along the way!

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 

After a few quiet months a lot of progress has been made and I am happy to announce the partnership between Hauntsville and Indie.io! 

For those of you who may not know, having a game publisher like Indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, publishers help in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with.

Indie.io will help bring Hauntsville to more Gamers and ensure the success of the project like it has done with other Games! 

You can check out their other great Indie Games here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio


Now I can focus even more on development and have the proper support to make Hauntsville the great Game I envisioned it to be!
 
Don’t forget to wishlist the game and join our Discord community to be notified of future announcements!

Thanks for everyone that follows along!
